title: Ellie: the girl who could have saved the world
subject: ellie
description:
The story of Ellie Williams from The Last of Us, and the lie that changed everything. Spoilers for The Last of Us Part I.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Naughty Dog or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Ellie was fourteen when one bite made her the most important person on Earth.
She grew up in a world that had already ended, locked inside the Boston quarantine zone, never knowing her mother.
One night she snuck into an abandoned mall with her best friend Riley. They were both bitten. Riley turned. Ellie didn't.
She was immune, and the Fireflies believed her body held the cure. So a hardened smuggler named Joel was hired to carry her across a ruined America.
Through a year of hunger, winter and loss, the job became something else. Joel became the father she never had.
Then, in Salt Lake City, the Fireflies revealed the price. Making the cure meant operating on her brain, and she would not survive.
Joel killed his way into the operating room and carried her out. And then, he lied to her face.
She asked him to swear it was all true. He swore. And everything that happens to Ellie next begins with that lie.
Would you have forgiven Joel? Tell me in the comments.
